title: MendingMaster
description: Repair your tools with your own experience levels using a simple command.
body:
LevelMend streamlines the Mending experience by giving players direct control over their repair costs. Why wait for random XP orbs when you have levels ready to spend?

This plugin introduces a straightforward command, /mending [level], that allows you to sacrifice your experience levels to repair the Mending item in your hand. It respects the classic Mending mechanic, providing a fast, balanced, and convenient way to maintain your gear.

Core Mechanics:

Command: /mending <amount> - Repairs the held Mending item using the specified number of levels.

Balanced Conversion: Follows vanilla Mending logic: 1 XP level = 2 durability points.

Safety First: The plugin automatically calculates the exact number of levels needed for a full repair, preventing any waste of experience points.

Permission & Messages: Optional permission nodes (levelmend.use) and fully customizable messages for a seamless server experience.
